SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, ATTRIBUTE1 AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE' AND SEGMENT1 = '-' AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
                   WHERE I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE = 'CELL'
                     AND I.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId AND I.ITEM_ID = @itemId
                     AND @itemId IS NOT NULL AND @itemId <> 'ALL')

FROM SCM_MST_SITE S
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.COMPANY_ID, I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
        FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
       WHERE I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_TYPE IS NOT NULL

         AND (@divisionId IS NULL OR I.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId)
         AND (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId = 'ALL' OR I.ITEM_ID = @itemId)) SS
  ON S.DIVISION_ID = SS.DIVISION_ID AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = SS.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
 AND S.COMPANY_ID = SS.COMPANY_ID

  ON M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE' AND M.SEGMENT1 = S.SCM_SITE_ID AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
WHERE S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' AND S.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' AND S.OSP_YN = 'N'

SELECT DISTINCT CODE, NAME FROM (
  /* (1) END_CUSTOMER lookup axis - div 40 표기 원천 [E20260814-ENDCUST] */
  SELECT L.SEGMENT2 AS CODE, NVL(L.SEGMENT3, L.SEGMENT2) AS NAME
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
  WHERE  L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND L.SEGMENT2 <> '-'
  AND    ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') = '-' OR L.SEGMENT1 = TRIM(@divisionId) )
  UNION ALL
  /* (2) div 40 : SITE_ITEM owner axis (AS-IS EndCustomerByDivision40) */
  SELECT A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE, NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
  JOIN   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B ON B.USER_ID = TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.OWNER, '[^,]+', 1, 1))
  JOIN   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON C.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
         ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2
        AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  WHERE  A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND TRIM(@divisionId) = '40' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
  UNION ALL
  /* (3) div 81/82 : 조회조건과 동일 축 = SCM_MST_SITE.END_CUSTOMER (AS-IS BigFilter
         EndCustomerByDivision 의 비40 분기 원문과 동일) [E20260818-ENDCUST81] */
  SELECT S.END_CUSTOMER AS CODE, NVL(D.SEGMENT3, S.END_CUSTOMER) AS NAME
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE S
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
         ON D.SEGMENT1 = S.DIVISION_ID AND D.SEGMENT2 = S.END_CUSTOMER
        AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  WHERE  S.END_CUSTOMER IS NOT NULL AND NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') <> '-'
  AND    S.DIVISION_ID = TRIM(@divisionId) AND TRIM(@divisionId) <> '40'
) ORDER BY NAME

SELECT CODE, NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ FROM (
  /* [E20260814-WSDIV → E20260819-FCSTTYPE6] 81 계열 + DM Planner(W/S)
     → SALES_TYPE_CODE2 ∪ SALES_TYPE_CODE2_ADD 6종 (2026-08-19 통합테스트 —
     AS-IS DMF0003 FcstTypeEditMode 동형. 구 4종엔 CODE2_ADD(Recall/RMA) 누락) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME
       , CASE LOOKUP_TYPE WHEN 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2' THEN DISPLAY_SEQ ELSE 100 + DISPLAY_SEQ END AS DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE IN ('SALES_TYPE_CODE2', 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2_ADD')
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
  AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                 WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y')
  UNION ALL
  /* division 전달 + W/S 자격 아님 → SALES_TYPE_CODE 에서 전용플래그(ATTRIBUTE2='Y' — 실측 WS/WSF 2건 유일) 제외 = 12종 */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, ' ') <> 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') <> '-'
  AND    NOT ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                           WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') )
  UNION ALL
  /* division 미전달(메타 셀 콤보 = CODE->NAME 표시 매핑) → 전 코드 1행씩 (중복 없음) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') = '-'
) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ, CODE

SELECT CODE, NAME FROM (
-- ══ 82 지정메저 분기 (원문 IF @PARAM1='82' AND ISNULL(@PARAM5,'')<>'') ══
SELECT SEGMENT2 AS CODE, SEGMENT3 AS NAME, 0 AS DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MKT_FCST_MEASURE'
  AND SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
  AND SEGMENT2 = @measure
  AND NVL(@divisionId,'-') = '82' AND @measure IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
-- ══ ELSE: TMM 제외 일반 MEASURE (원문 1:1 — VMI_YN = SCM_MST_SITE(@divisionId,@scmSiteId)) ══
SELECT L.SEGMENT2 AS CODE, L.SEGMENT3 AS NAME, L.DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
WHERE 1=1
  AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MKT_FCST_MEASURE'
  AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND L.ATTRIBUTE2 <> 'Y'  -- TMM Measure여부
  AND L.SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
  AND L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y'     -- INSERT_YN 여부
  --[C20201015-000200]
  AND ( ( NVL((SELECT S.VMI_YN FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId AND S.SCM_SITE_ID=@scmSiteId),'N') = 'N' AND L.ATTRIBUTE1 <> 'Y' )
     OR ( NVL((SELECT S.VMI_YN FROM SCM_MST_SITE S WHERE S.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId AND S.SCM_SITE_ID=@scmSiteId),'N') = 'Y' ) )
  AND ( NVL(@divisionId,'-') <> '82' OR @measure IS NULL )
UNION ALL
-- ══ ELSE: CUST_FCST MEASURE (원문 1:1) ══
SELECT T.CODE, T.NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T.CODE) + 900 AS DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CF.MEASURE AS CODE, ' └ ' || CF.MEASURE AS NAME
	  FROM DM_MST_CUSTOMER_FCST CF
	  WHERE CF.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND CF.MEASURE_GROUP = 'CUST_FCST'
		AND CF.DIVISION_ID = @divisionId
		AND CF.SCM_SITE_ID = @scmSiteId) T
WHERE ( NVL(@divisionId,'-') <> '82' OR @measure IS NULL )
UNION ALL
-- ══ ELSE: TMM Measure (원문 1:1 — TMM_MEASURE_ADMIN 게이트 TOP1=ROWNUM) ══
SELECT L.SEGMENT2, L.SEGMENT3, L.DISPLAY_SEQ
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
INNER JOIN (SELECT VALID_YN, SEGMENT1, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT4
			FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
			WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'TMM_MEASURE_ADMIN'
			  AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
			  AND SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
			  AND SEGMENT2 = @projectCode
			  AND SEGMENT4 = @sesUserId
			  AND ROWNUM = 1) T
  ON ( L.SEGMENT1 = T.SEGMENT1
   AND L.VALID_YN = T.VALID_YN
   AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'MKT_FCST_MEASURE'
   AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND L.SEGMENT1 = @divisionId
   AND L.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
   AND L.SEGMENT4 = 'Y' )
WHERE ( NVL(@divisionId,'-') <> '82' OR @measure IS NULL )
) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

	   S.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID

	 , S.COMPANY_ID AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT I.DIVISION_ID, I.COMPANY_ID, I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP --[C20200608-000328] SalesCompany 콤보는 Item Master의 Company ID, Operation Group 기준으로 조회
			FROM   SCM_MST_PROJECT_ITEM SI

			AND    I.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			AND    (I.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' OR I.DIVISION_ID = '82')

			AND    (@divisionId IS NULL OR @divisionId='' OR SI.DIVISION_ID=@divisionId)
			AND    (@projectCode IS NULL OR @projectCode='' OR SI.PROJECT_CODE=@projectCode)
			AND    (@itemId IS NULL OR @itemId='' OR SI.ITEM_ID=@itemId)

	   A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
	 , B.DEPT_ID       AS CODE
	 , CASE @langCd WHEN 'EN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_EN
	                WHEN 'CN' THEN B.DEPT_NAME_CN
	                ELSE B.DEPT_NAME_KO
	                END AS NAME
FROM   SCM_MST_SITE          A
	 , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B
WHERE  A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
AND    A.DEPT_ID  = B.DEPT_ID
AND    CASE WHEN NVL(@divisionId,'ALL') = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL'
	   ELSE A.DIVISION_ID
	   END  IN ( SELECT TOKEN FROM TABLE(SCM_MGR.FN_STRING_SPLIT(NVL(@divisionId,'ALL'),',')) )

		FROM   SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
		WHERE  USER_ID = @sesUserId
		AND    UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
		AND    USE_YN = 'Y')  -- 원문 TB_FX_UserGroupAuthExtention(AuthType='D') = TO-BE 권한 체계 대체(UserTeamByDivision 선례 동일)
AND    NVL(@divisionId,'ALL') <> '40'  -- 원문 IF @Param1<>'40' (''→'ALL' 전처리 포함 — Oracle ''=NULL→NVL)
UNION ALL
-- ══ 40 분기 (원문 ELSE — site_item OWNER 1번 토큰 사용자의 부서) — 원문 1:1 ══

	 , SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B
	 , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C

SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, B.DEPT_ID AS CODE, B.DEPT_NAME_KO AS NAME
FROM SCM_MST_SITE A JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B ON A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID CROSS JOIN F
WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40' AND F.TEAM_CNT <= 1
  AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M
                        WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
  AND (F.IS_ADMIN > 0 OR B.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM ME))
UNION
SELECT '40', C.DEPT_ID, C.DEPT_NAME_KO
FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B ON A.OWNER = B.USER_ID
JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID CROSS JOIN F
WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND F.TEAM_CNT <= 1
  AND (F.IS_ADMIN > 0 OR C.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM ME))
UNION
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, B.DEPT_ID, B.DEPT_NAME_KO
FROM SCM_MST_SITE A JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B ON A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID CROSS JOIN F
WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40' AND F.TEAM_CNT > 1
  AND B.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM MAPSET)
UNION
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, B2.DEPT_ID, B2.DEPT_NAME_KO
FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM I ON A.DIVISION_ID = I.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = I.SCM_SITE_ID
JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU ON SU.USER_ID = I.OWNER
JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO B2 ON B2.DEPT_ID = SU.DEPT_ID CROSS JOIN F
WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND F.TEAM_CNT > 1
  AND B2.DEPT_ID IN (SELECT DEPT_ID FROM MAPSET)
) ORDER BY CODE
SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, T1.SEGMENT2 NAME      FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1     WHERE  1=1       AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'TIME_ZONE'       AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'  ORDER BY  T1.DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT  T1.SEGMENT1 CODE, NVL(MSG.MSG_NM, T1.DESCRIPTION) NAME      FROM  SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL T1 LEFT JOIN  SCM_ADM_MSG_M MSG        ON  T1.SEGMENT2 = MSG.MSG_ID       AND  MSG.LANG_CD = @sesLangCd     WHERE  1=1       AND  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'UNIT_TP_CD'       AND  T1.VALID_YN = 'Y'  ORDER BY  T1.LOOKUP_TYPE, T1.DISPLAY_SEQ
SELECT 		SEGMENT1 AS CODE 	  , SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL where LOOKUP_TYPE ='UPLOAD_UOM_TYPE_CODE' order by DISPLAY_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT D.DEPT_ID AS CODE , D.DEPT_NAME_KO AS NAME FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE A , SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D , SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO T WHERE A.DEPT_ID = T.DEPT_ID AND D.DEPT_ID = T.UPPER_DEPT_ID AND A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
SELECT	G.USER_GR_ID AS CODE, G.USER_GR_NM AS NAME FROM 	SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M G WHERE	G.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY G.USER_GR_ID

SELECT CODE, NAME FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT A.SCM_SITE_ID AS CODE, A.SCM_SITE_ID AS NAME, 2 AS SORT_ORDER
FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(A.OPERATION_GROUP, ' ') <> 'W'
  AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || A.DIVISION_ID || ',') > 0)
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@endCustomer), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || A.END_CUSTOMER || ',') > 0)
  AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, 2
FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B ON A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT U.USER_ID, U.DEPT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D2 ON U.DEPT_ID = D2.DEPT_ID) C
  ON B.OWNER = C.USER_ID
WHERE A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(A.OPERATION_GROUP, ' ') <> 'W'
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',40,') > 0)
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@deptId), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @deptId || ',', ',' || C.DEPT_ID || ',') > 0)
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@endCustomer), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @endCustomer || ',', ',' || B.PROJECT_CODE || ',') > 0)
  AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
UNION ALL
SELECT L.SEGMENT1, B.SITE_DESCRIPTION, 1
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
JOIN SCM_MST_SITE B ON L.SEGMENT3 = B.DIVISION_ID AND L.SEGMENT1 = B.SCM_SITE_ID
WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'AS_SITE_PLANT' AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y' AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND (NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), 'ALL') = 'ALL' OR INSTR(',' || @divisionId || ',', ',' || L.SEGMENT3 || ',') > 0)
) ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, CODE

SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID, C.DEPT_ID AS CODE
     , CASE @langCd WHEN 'EN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_EN WHEN 'CN' THEN C.DEPT_NAME_CN ELSE C.DEPT_NAME_KO END AS NAME
FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A, SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B, SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C
WHERE B.USER_ID = TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.OWNER, '[^,]+', 1, 1))
  AND B.DEPT_ID = C.DEPT_ID
  AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT UNIT_ID FROM SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M WHERE USER_ID = @sesUserId AND UNIT_TP_CD = 'D' AND USE_YN = 'Y')
ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, NAME, CODE
